title: Bubble Ship in Space
description: A man and woman wearing clear astronaut helmets sit together on a red and purple bench inside a large transparent bubble. The bubble floats in a dark purple space-like background with floating bubbles, red and blue paw prints, and bright blue and purple electrical energy bolts connecting to the bubble.
prompt: A couple wearing astronaut helmets sits on a retro red and purple bench inside a giant transparent soap bubble floating in space. The bubble is surrounded by smaller bubbles, floating red and blue paw prints, and bright blue and purple electrical energy arcs. The man and woman are smiling at each other, the woman holds up a pink paw print. Dark cosmic background with purple and red horizontal stripes, vibrant digital painting style.
